initial_condition: Thin pen lies on the visible table; the specified holder and gripper are visible.
goal: Place the thin pen inside the specified holder and verify independent support.
constraints: RGB-only object judgment; no calibration, simulator object state or historical motion targets.
One bounded action proposal per observation cycle; preserve execution limits and uncertainty latches.
Model visual claims and independently reviewed outcomes must be reported separately.

steps.goal: Identify the specified objects, initial state and available RGB views; freeze the task variant.
Approach the thin pen along a visually clear route.
Align the open fingers with a feasible grasp on the thin pen.
Grasp the thin pen and verify retention after separation from its support.
Carry the retained pen toward the specified holder.
Align the actual pen axis and tip with the holder opening using current RGB.
Lower the pen into the opening in bounded segments; check for rim contact and real entry.
Release only after support is established, then withdraw the empty gripper.
Verify the pen remains inside the holder after withdrawal.
